snippet.title: Penguin Colony Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
Narrative adventure game based on H.P Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness. Swim, Slide and Explore open ended levels as multiple penguin types with different abilities and challenges.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3695930/Penguin_Colony/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!
